package.name: bluerov_sitl
package.description: A software-in-the-loop stand-in for a BlueROV2 Heavy flight controller. Reproduces ArduSub's MANUAL and STABILIZE modes and the AP_Motors6DOF thruster mixing for the vectored_6dof frame in ROS2: subscribes to mavros/rc/override (mavros_msgs/OverrideRCIn) and publishes the per-thruster PWM the real flight controller would drive the ESCs with. The mixing matrix and controller gains are extracted from a vendored ArduSub checkout rather than hand-copied.
